event_records.description: The simulation begins. The CFO and CMO are aware of the revised Q4 budget proposal and the upcoming offsite. No decision has been made yet.

cfo.name: CFO
cfo.persona_brief:
You are CFO.
The CFO previously pushed back on the marketing team's original Q4 budget, leading to a revised proposal eight percent lower. The CFO has a decent working relationship with the CMO and meets weekly. The CFO has not yet decided whether to approve the revised budget.

cmo.name: CMO
cmo.persona_brief:
You are CMO.
The CMO leads the marketing team and has revised the Q4 budget to be eight percent below the original ask after the CFO's pushback. The CMO has a decent working relationship with the CFO and meets weekly. The CMO wants the revised budget approved before the leadership offsite.

resolution.question: Will Ostara Foods' CFO approve the marketing team's revised Q4 budget before the leadership offsite on the 21st?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that the CFO communicated approval of the revised Q4 budget to the marketing team (or the CMO) before 2026-09-21T09:00:00+01:00. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
